## Reading in hate

```{r}
hatedata <-read_tsv("C:\\Users\\lbmoy2\\Downloads\\hateCrime.tsv", col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("."))

as_tibble(hatedata) %>%
  rename("state" = X1,
         "med_inc" = X2,
         "unemp" = X3,
         "pop_metro" = X4,
         "pop_hs" = X5,
         "non_citizen" = X6,
         "white_poverty" = X7,
         "non_white" = X8,
         "vote_trump" = X9,
         "hate_crimes_per_100k" = X10,
         "avg_hatecrimes_per_100k" = X11,
         ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(med_inc)) %>%
  arrange(med_inc) %>%
  select(!c(desc(med_inc) , non_white)) %>%
  print()
  
```
